onboarding1Title: All your health records in one place
onboarding1Desc: MediVault allows patients to keep their doctor visits, lab reports, and prescriptions seamlessly organized in one private, secure application.
onboarding2Desc: Your doctor visits, diagnoses, medications, and medical reports are automatically categorized by medical specialty for instant clinical access.
onboarding3Desc: Control exactly what medical information you want to share with your doctor using a time-limited secure link or quick QR code scan.
